title: Error Diffusion Replaces Latent Weights: Training Binary-Weight Language Models on a Few Bits of Dithered State
abstract: arXiv:2610.34566v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Binary-weight language models store one bit per weight, but training them keeps a full-precision latent copy of each weight plus Adam state, about 96 extra bits per weight, so a deployed binary model cannot be adapted on the device that runs it. We replace the latent weight with a 2-8-bit residual buffer quantized by stochastic rounding, which cuts the training state per weight from 97 bits to 3-9, up to 19x less. The resulting error-diffusion (ED) optimizer moves the residual-carrying loop of image halftoning onto the weight-update path. Each buffer accumulates the unrealized part of every update and flips the weight when the accumulated value crosses a threshold, and it works only when its quantization grid has a level exactly at that threshold. Under this threshold-alignment rule, 4-bit buffers match 8-bit buffers on a binary multilayer perceptron benchmark, and the same rule lifts a different latent-free optimizer, Bop, from a 10-poi

translated_title: 误差扩散取代潜在权重：在几比特抖动状态上训练二值权重语言模型
translated_abstract: 二值权重语言模型每个权重仅存储一个比特，但训练它们需要为每个权重保留一份全精度的潜在副本外加Adam状态，每个权重约需额外96比特，因此已部署的二值模型无法在运行它的设备上进行适配。我们用由随机舍入量化的2-8比特残差缓冲区取代潜在权重，将每个权重的训练状态从97比特削减至3-9比特，最多减少19倍。由此得到的误差扩散（ED）优化器将图像半色调处理中的残差传递循环移植到了权重更新路径上。每个缓冲区累积每次更新中未实现的部分，当累积值越过某个阈值时翻转权重，且只有当其量化网格中恰好存在该阈值对应的量化级别时才能正常工作。在这一阈值对齐规则下，4比特缓冲区在二值多层感知机基准测试中与8比特缓冲区表现相当，且同样的规则使另一种无潜在优化器Bop的性能从10个百分点……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出误差扩散（ED）优化器，用2-8比特随机舍入残差缓冲区取代全精度潜在权重，将二值权重语言模型每个权重的训练状态从97比特降至3-9比特（最多减少19倍），并揭示优化仅在量化网格恰好包含翻转阈值时才能成立。
en_tdlr: Proposes an error-diffusion (ED) optimizer that replaces full-precision latent weights with 2-8-bit stochastic-rounding residual buffers, cutting per-weight training state for binary-weight language models from 97 bits to 3-9 bits (up to 19x less), and shows optimization works only when the quantization grid contains the weight-flip threshold exactly.
